targets.title: Original polynomial-time writers
targets.evidence: Kernel-verified at the original scope. For every polynomial p, machine M and input, the actual machines windowMTM p and inputMTM M p write originalWindowCode p x and originalInputCode M p x at their first halt within explicit polynomial transition bounds (windowMTM_outputs, inputMTM_outputs). Hence originalWindowCode_fp, originalInputCode_fp, the unconditional originalWM, originalWM_first_answer (T_W = 2 T_M), originalWM_decides and P_Turing_subset_P_disc_by_original. Gate scripts/verify_ii10_original_wm.sh passed on commit df8824c: Lean 4.23.0, lake build PVNP 7,386 jobs, 627 audited declarations with standard axioms only, 24 Python regression tests.
targets.remaining_obligation: None for the original claim. GitHub-hosted CI has not executed for this head (issue #59); the kernel evidence is the local exact-head gate.

targets.title: Uniform separator theorem
targets.evidence: Refuted for the frozen physical trajectory class. SeparatorFrozen.no_uniform_separator_price: on the torus of side L, the exact plane-wave solutions of fixed amplitude A have curvature functional at most 4π²|A|² + 16π⁴c²|A|²/L² (any curvature operator dominated by c|Δψ|, including Δ and the Part III Θ_ε), while the Euclidean length of the frontier of the decision region {Re ψ > 0} is at least L, at every time. These fields are used by an admissible decider (stripe_device_decides); the modulus readout fails the same way (no_uniform_price_modulus). Corrected statement: layer_price (sharp width-dependent price 4η²/w).
targets.remaining_obligation: None for the original hypothesis. A uniform price needs an extra hypothesis bounding transition widths (sharp interfaces), under which SeparatorPrice.mesh_price and SeparatorFrozen.layer_price apply.

targets.title: General toroidal locking
targets.evidence: Obstruction (TorusNoLocking): the frozen flow is time-reversible (isSolution_reverse); a solution converging to a nonempty, Lyapunov-stable, conjugation-invariant lock set starts in it (no_locking), which covers the phase orbit of every binary-phase state (no_locking_phaseOrbit). Earlier: finite formula-dependent logical tori.
targets.remaining_obligation: Define the locking constraints. Any robust realization needs dissipative or forced dynamics outside the frozen model, with a bidirectional locking correspondence, convergence and charged construction/readout bounds.

targets.title: Encoding-independent interface theorem
targets.evidence: ExpanderInterface.expanderGrowth_SAT_iff: in the charged constant-device class the hypothesis for dense SAT is equivalent to P_TM ≠ NP_TM; expanderGrowth_implies_P_ne_NP for any class containing those devices; false for every language in P_TM. Binary-cut graph price and storage upper bounds exist.
targets.remaining_obligation: Cannot be proved without proving P_TM ≠ NP_TM; in the constant-device class it cannot be refuted without P_TM = NP_TM.

targets.title: Physical SAT dynamics and readout
targets.evidence: PartIPsiSat energy threshold, rounding and noisy certificate readout are proved. Torus.no_locking_phaseOrbit: the frozen dynamics cannot converge into a stable binary-phase lock from outside it.
targets.remaining_obligation: Formula-dependent dissipative dynamics with certified convergence, completeness and robust observations; the frozen model cannot provide the convergence.

targets.title: Continuum physical-computation equivalence
targets.evidence: Uniform discrete P/NP class equivalences are proved with charged encoding; unrestricted physical encoder countermodel known.
targets.remaining_obligation: Prove both charged physical-to-TM simulation and language-independent physical TM realization with PDE approximation errors.

targets.title: Nonconstructible wavefield family
targets.evidence: DepthBarrier.explicit_no_separation: in the explicit-state reading every state is constructed in linear time, so NPst \ Pst = ∅. Conditional symbolic separation template proved earlier.
targets.remaining_obligation: Fix a state notion (input-indexed families or physical fields with a preparation model) under which the conjecture is non-trivial, then construct or refute a verifiable non-constructible target.

targets.title: Universal SAT lower bound
targets.evidence: DepthBarrier.wccDepth_SAT_iff, wccdDepth_SAT_iff, uniform_depth_SAT_iff: for dense SAT the conjecture is exactly P_TM ≠ NP_TM. Quadratic single-tape bounds at every budget exist.
targets.remaining_obligation: This is the classical P versus NP question; it is not resolved here, and finite data cannot establish it.
